notes.title: Brick Cracker 3D Update V1.3 is Coming!
notes.content:
Hello dear Brick Cracker 3D players! 🧱🎉

Our game turns 3 years old on February 9th! To celebrate this amazing milestone, I’m working on a brand-new update: Update 1.3! I know the first version of the game felt a bit simple, but it was my very first game. Now, under the name of Pixcodream and as a one-person team, I’m working hard to make it more colorful, more fun, and more consistent.

The update will be completely free! However, you might need to be patient, as the release date hasn’t been finalized yet. 😅 Pixcodream is a game development studio where creativity meets code and pixels. For now, it’s just a one-person team, but the dreams are big!

Our former publisher, Unitive Gameworks, is officially closed, and we’re moving forward under the Pixcodream name. I believe together we can take bigger steps toward exciting projects. Your feedback means a lot to me, so don’t hesitate to share your thoughts. 🎮✨

notes.title: Brick Cracker 3D V1.2 Update
notes.content:
The game's official version 1.2 patch has been released. In this patch, the visual bugs in the game have been fixed. In addition, the following changes were made.

- Fixed the issue where bricks would go out of the game area in some chapters.
- Fixed the bug where the ball in the game got stuck at some points.
- Removed the annoying white line at the top of the playing field.
- Added warning video for glowing lights in some sections.
